text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Rushing past like a gale alongside a 
thunderous roar. Stealing everyone's gaze, 
capturing their very hearts—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —It's closing in.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A scorching, radiant glow.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*, ...gh! Haha, hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...! That's the spirit...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Orfe! Orfevre! —Welcome back, Orfevre!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Win Variatiooon! Vari-yaaann! That was 
amazing! Thank you for moving us so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Haa, haa... Ha, haha...!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I knew it... you really are special...!

Though they missed out on victory, the 
fierce duel between the two was utterly 
breathtaking, and the cheers didn't die 
down for a long time—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Cutting straight to the point, what are 
your plans for your next race?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Next up is—the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had already spoken with Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... I wanna run in it! If 
I can enter, I definitely want to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's the year-end GⅠ race where entries 
are decided by fan votes. Orfevre will 
almost certainly be running.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There's an Umamusume... that I've been 
chasing after all this time.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre. Everyone's dream—the king who 
forged an era. More dazzling than anyone, 
the ultimate protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I want to surpass her brilliance. It 
was that desire that brought me this far.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I felt a real breakthrough 
today. It feels like the number of people 
watching me has grown to rival hers.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why in the next race... in the 
Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"At the Arima Kinen—the very race that 
plunged me into rock bottom. This time, 
I'm going to steal the spotlight from 
her."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Together with my best partner who has 
supported me all the way hereâmy 
Trainer!

Win Variation's words of determination 
spread in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"It's true, Orfevre really is 'The 
Protagonist' personified! You just can't 
take your eyes off her when she runs."

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
She was already the talk of the town 
before her debut, after all. Her presence 
alone is extraordinary...

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
We've been watching Bari-yan ever since 
the Classic Year, haven't we! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Chasing relentlessly without letting go, 
staring down Orfevre the entire time!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Watching you really gives me courage, 
Shion-san. It makes me wonder if I could 
be like that too if I try hard.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Equal to before—no. Has it become even 
greater than that?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hehehe... Hahaha! Ah, yes, ah...! 
Peculiar fire—no, seething fierce flame, 
you have served well...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Yet, I shall not allow it to be reduced 
to ash.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A scorched wasteland is not part of the 
plan. From here on out, not a single name 
shall be etched.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the true 'King'... 
First, let it shine at the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe—

"—Everything she had built up to this 
point was beginning to bloom, and she 
herself could feel the spotlight upon 
her."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
S-Some underclassman I didn't even know 
told me "Good luck!" again today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It was a little embarrassing, but after 
all... it got me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'll run a race where I shine 
so bright that nobody will even be looking 
at her."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best together!
Yeah, let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm heading out for a run around 
the perimeter!

To make a grand flower bloom on the 
year-end's grandest stage, the Arima 
Kinen... And so, the days of running full 
speed alongside her began!
